subject: Mythology
title: The Olympics: Mythology as Sport
description: Learn The Olympics: Mythology as Sport in one minute.

hook.text: The Olympic Games began in 776 BCE as a religious festival honoring Zeus at Olympia, Greece.

buildup.text: Ancient athletes competed naked, wars paused for the games, and winners wore olive wreaths like demigods.

discovery.text: The modern Olympics revived in 1896 keep the mythological spirit: the torch relay, the oath, and the laurel crown.

twist.text: The Olympic rings were invented in 1913 — they have no ancient origin despite looking timeless and mythological.

climax.text: 3.2 billion people watched. The world's biggest event still runs on a mythological framework from ancient Greece.

punchline.text: A festival for Zeus became the biggest gathering on earth. Nobody worships Zeus.

quiz.question: What is the origin of the five Olympic rings?
options: They represent the five Greek gods who founded the games
They were invented in 1913 and have no ancient origin
They come from five interlocking shields found at Olympia
